description:
FILED s540a (Opus agent, 2026-11-13) from the CPAN board timing (#4787; docs/cpan-speed-comparison-s540.md section 4, the per-file table baselines/board-timing-s540.tsv; tool tools/board-timing.pl).  Times are CPU seconds, code 381d9063 (MAIN-READY-89), coarse pass load-normalised, lever A/Bs on a quiet box (heavy.sh bench, best of 3).

WHAT: p-ensure-test-lib does (load path) on cl/pcl-test.lisp, so SBCL compiles the whole TAP layer (169 top-level forms) in every run that says `use Test::More` -- 0.37 s CPU quiet (the tcompile bucket; 0.9-1.1 s at load 10+), 224.9 s over the 611 board files that use it (29 dists).  It is the same work in every file, which is why section 1a of the doc uses it as the load-inflation calibrator.

LEVER: route it through the extension fasl cache (%p-load-extension-file, the path cl/pcl-pack.lisp / pcl-mro.lisp take since #1202), keyed by the file's bytes + the runtime identity.

DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (TAKEN, scratch/s540a/bench1.log, bench1-L1-*.tsv): the TAP layer compiled once to a fasl and loaded in front of the program (tools/board-timing.pl --preload pcl-test.fasl), best of 3, 6 files of 6 dists: -0.37..-0.41 s each (Class-Method-Modifiers 003-basic.t 0.77 -> 0.39 s, File-Which 01_use.t 0.64 -> 0.25, Data-Dumper bless.t 2.17 -> 1.80); the fasl load itself < 10 ms.

CHECK BEFORE BUILDING: the gate harness and the sweep preload cl/pcl-test.lisp themselves (fboundp 'pl-ok short-circuits p-ensure-test-lib); the .lisp references *current-test-file* and harness functions that are defined later (compile warnings seen when compiling it as a file) -- a fasl build must keep those as run-time references.  Size: one session.
=== s540 (2026-11-13) === a HARNESS-side change (the TAP layer`s load path): goes to s539a (the harness half), which has the companion --all --quick as its per-batch leg already.


=== DONE (s539a) ===
p-ensure-test-lib loads cl/pcl-test.lisp through %p-load-extension-file "pcl-test" (the #1202 path): compiled once per content + runtime identity.  A Test::More program 0.98 -> 0.32 s (load ~7, three runs each; the fasl hit itself 9-10 ms).  The file needed one change to compile clean: *current-test-file* was read by two functions above its defvar (three compile WARNINGs = a build that reports failure) -- the defvar moved up.  CHECK BEFORE BUILDING, each taken: the gate / sweep `--load` the text first and pl-ok fbound short-circuits (the sweep is unchanged: 18,803 +0); PCL_NO_FASL_CACHE=1 loads the text; an edit of the file makes a new entry and drops the superseded one (probed); the IR inventory was regenerated for the new export (pl-todo_skip).  NOT taken (budget): board-timing over the six files and tools/t/install-pcl.t; the sweep / gate preloads could take the same path (a runner change, not made).  Guard Pl/t/tap-assert-01.t row 44 (built -> FASL HIT -> TEXT under PCL_NO_FASL_CACHE, same TAP; fails on the base).
subject: PERF (CPAN board #2, 225 s): the Test::More layer cl/pcl-test.lisp (1,822 lines) is SOURCE-loaded -- compiled by SBCL -- in every program that uses Test::More (p-ensure-test-lib calls `load` on the .lisp); 0.37 s per file, 611 board files; preloading it from a fasl removes all of it
